mentions.name: Competitive Pokémon AI (metamon fork)
mentions.description: Trains AI agents for 1v1 competitive Pokémon battles on Pokémon Showdown, using imitation learning on player actions and exploring reward-free models and JEPA-style world models for improved planning. The goal is to match or exceed the prior 142M-parameter Kakuna baseline model within a limited training budget, building on plugins from the competitive Pokémon NeurIPS track.
mentions.source_excerpt: I thought that applying AI on 1v1 competitive pokemon would be a fun and educational experience on POMDPs and trying out reward free models on a problem that would be classically treated as a RL problem.

evidence.value: I thought that applying AI on 1v1 competitive pokemon would be a fun and educational experience on POMDPs and trying out reward free models on a problem that would be classically treated as a RL problem.
